11. The Great Inventor

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager praised as a hero for helping repair a footbridge finds the attention deeply embarrassing.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has been praised for helping repair a damaged footbridge. The villagers call (subject.him/her) a hero. (subject) finds this deeply embarrassing. (subject.He/She) was simply nearby, knew how to work with rope, and didn't want anyone falling into the stream.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: "Thank you," says (subject), somewhat awkwardly. Later (subject.he/she) admits to (friend) that the attention was uncomfortable. "You can be pleased with what you did without enjoying the fuss," (friend) replies.

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: "It was a team effort," says (subject). "Speaking of which, has anyone seen my hammer?" The villagers eventually stop praising (subject.him/her), much to (subject.his/her) relief. The bridge remains in excellent condition.
